name: Personal Bank: a soulbound item deposited this session can be withdrawn again
contract: The Personal Bank item 134985 says soulbound items can be put into the bank. A character bank belongs to that character, so an item it deposits keeps the character as owner while the bank stays open: withdrawing it in the same session returns it to the bags instead of answering "You don't own that item".

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Let the vault summon land in the world
The soulbound item is in the bags
Deposit the soulbound item in the first bank slot
Withdraw it again without closing the bank
The withdrawn soulbound item is back in the bags
